shared_commerce_spine: DreamLedger canonical checkout and fulfillment evidence; no separate revenue ledger

acceptance: Persistent topic threads and replies
Pagination and stable topic URLs so new posts do not bury prior discussions
Moderation, report/block controls, rate limits, and server-side authorization
RLS or equivalent access policies and automated policy tests
Authenticated channel membership and private-channel authorization
Messages persist across reloads and reconnects
Realtime delivery test across two distinct authenticated sessions
Rate limits, moderation, retention policy, and RLS tests
Database and realtime service health verified at runtime
Browse without an account
Free account required to create or edit a seller listing
Seller identity, item rights, format, territory, condition, price, and fulfillment declared
No fake inventory; seller ownership checked server-side
Listing submission and retrieval verified end to end
Separate promotion SKU, canonical Stripe Price ID, currency, amount, and live/test mode match
Settled payment verified from Stripe, not from a checkout URL or session alone
Unique placement reservation is committed idempotently after settlement
Promoted listing is labelled and expires at the purchased time
Moderation and rights review completed before display
Refund, duplicate webhook, cancellation, and unavailable-inventory cases tested
Placement and delivery evidence recorded with hashes

hard_gates: Do not advertise feature as live until acceptance tests pass
Do not activate paid promotion while inventory reservation or settlement verification is unverified
Do not expose private user data across silos
Do not publish, purchase, contact buyers, or change production credentials as part of this implementation
No user-submitted copyrighted or unlicensed media may be used as demo inventory
runtime_blockers: Supabase Postgres/PostgREST connectivity has prior PGRST002 and storage exhaustion evidence; current recovery requires fresh read-only health proof
Forum/chat RLS and authorization evidence not yet established
Promotion checkout-to-reservation-to-delivery path not yet end-to-end verified
